summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin, per the spec. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: new Update class with prologue and algebra attributes, beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate returns an Update on every path; the empty-request early exit returns Update(translatePrologue([], base, initNs), []). (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: new prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) beside prepareQuery, sets _original_args; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update needed no change; processUpdate untouched. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (6) New test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py covering prepare-and-apply via Graph.update, reuse across graphs, initNs prefixes, initBindings, direct evalUpdate, container shape, empty request, empty update string, and a repr-based no-mutation check. Not run: per instructions, no tests or repo code were executed, so all results are verified by reading only. Not committed. Open item: DAWG update tests and the prepareQuery test are expected to pass but were not run.
